editor.title: Title
editor.kinds_hint: Matched on the device's model_id, so the list follows containers as they come and go.
editor.filter_hint: Comma-separated. * and ? are wildcards; a plain word matches anywhere in the name.
editor.max_rows_hint: The rest are folded behind a line that opens them. Leave empty for no limit.
editor.columns_hint: Two is the ceiling: Home Assistant gives a card about 500 px, which is two readable rows across — and two wants compact rows. A narrower card falls back to one.
editor.secondary_info_hint: Shown beside the state. A value the server cannot report right now is left out.
editor.show_server_summary_hint: Shows the server's load, memory and temperature under its name, and that name even with a single server.
editor.show_history_hint: Draws the last hour of CPU load and memory usage beside the server's rings. Needs the server summary and Home Assistant's recorder.
editor.show_services_hint: SSH, Samba, NFS, Tailscale and NetBird as chips under the server summary, lit while on.
editor.confirm_stop_hint: Only stopping asks. Starting is a second click away from being undone.
editor.show_problem_hint: Badges a device the integration reports a fault on — a SMART warning, an unhealthy container, a degraded pool.
editor.actions_hint: Applied to each row's own state entity, except Toggle, which uses the row's start/stop switch. In YAML, a placeholder such as [[name]] or [[entity]] anywhere in an action stands for the row that was tapped.

overview_editor.title: Title
overview_editor.navigation_path: Tap on a guest kind opens
overview_editor.navigation_path_hint: A dashboard path, for example /mos/containers. [[kind]] becomes the kind, e.g. docker_container. Leave empty for no tap.
